changes: All historical QUO are queryable from CRM with server-side filtering and pagination, including linked records and quotes without a historical name.
A human must select, review and confirm the quote IDs before binding them to the current CRM account.
Already-linked CRM accounts and converted leads are never overwritten; amount, status, revision and historical client-name snapshots remain unchanged.
Existing REST endpoints and notifications framework are preserved.

validation.code: Changes staged in intermediate branches; CI must prove build and regression suite.
validation.staging: Pending validation with actual pricing quote data and CRM account authorization.

rollback: Revert the coordinated release commits in DholeWeb and DholePricingService; no database schema migration is required.
